quality_guards: Chainsaw risk depends on saw type, task, timber, terrain, weather, operator competence, PPE, maintenance and emergency arrangements.
HSE chainsaw evidence is operator-, task-, equipment-, site-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Livestock risk depends on species, temperament, handling frequency, facilities, restraint, worker competence, visitors and task conditions.
HSE livestock evidence is animal-, facility-, worker-, task-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Abrasive-wheel risk depends on wheel type, machine speed, mounting, guarding, material, operator competence, maintenance and PPE.
HSE abrasive-wheel evidence is wheel-, machine-, operation-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Heat-stress risk depends on temperature, humidity, radiant heat, work rate, clothing, hydration, acclimatisation and individual susceptibility.
HSE heat-stress evidence is workplace-, climate-, task-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Giardiasis risk depends on water and food quality, animal or human contact, travel, swimming exposure, hygiene, immunity and timing.
UKHSA Giardia evidence is pathogen-, exposure-, traveller-, setting-, patient- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Scabies risk depends on case type, skin contact, setting, crowding, personal care, diagnosis delay, coordinated treatment and cleaning.
UKHSA scabies evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, treatment-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infestation probability.
Leprosy risk and presentation depend on organism burden, disease type, endemic exposure, incubation, host immunity, diagnosis and treatment timing.
UKHSA leprosy evidence is patient-, exposure-, disease-, diagnostic-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Fancy-dress risk depends on product design, fabric, cords, labelling, compliance, seller, child age, supervision and proximity to flame.
OPSS costume-test evidence is targeted-product-, marketplace-, test-, child-, use- and time-specific and is not a national non-compliance estimate or parcel-level injury probability.
Loss-of-control risk depends on aircraft type, flight phase, weather, pilot proficiency, angle of attack, systems, workload and startle response.
CAA loss-of-control evidence is aircraft-, pilot-, operation-, environment-, event- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Cargo-securing risk depends on cargo type, mass, packaging, ship design, securing equipment, voyage conditions, procedures and crew competence.
MCA cargo evidence is ship-, cargo-, voyage-, manual-, operation- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level maritime-incident probability.
